name: – Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz – After § 5 – Am 19
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: 5a. Commends the efforts of the Mexican Government to pursue, through the Fourth Transformation (4T), an economic and social model centred on fighting corruption, reducing poverty and reversing excessive inequalities, reflecting values shared with the EU; notes that this political project also aims at reducing Mexico’s excessive dependence on a single international partner and consolidating relations with alternative partners, making the modernisation of the EU-Mexico Agreement a strategic priority for Mexico itself; calls for the EU institutions to significantly strengthen political relations with Mexico, recognising it as a privileged political ally in the defence of multilateralism and sustainable development; urges the Council and the Commission to elevate the EU-Mexico relationship to the highest tier of external political partnerships, including through regular summits of heads of state, enhanced parliamentary diplomacy and a joint initiative on inclusive development and a just transition;
